summary: REQ-7/8/9 appear to be implemented: MusicPlayer now handles autoplay-blocked prompting, play/pause and volume affecting the active audio element; ProposalSection cycles through the specified English NO-click prompts as a flashing message and grows the YES button while keeping NO clickable and still submitting NO responses.

hallucinated_features.description: NO button progressively shrinks on each NO click (with a minimum scale), which was not explicitly requested.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-9 requires YES to grow and NO to remain selectable; it does not request shrinking NO.
